summary: Datavault AI Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a merger agreement dated August 19, 2026, to acquire WDT, LLC, parent of BankWyse, a Wyoming SPDI charter holder. The consideration is approximately $22.0 million, comprising $14.66 million in common stock and $7.34 million in cash, with up to $10.0 million in contingent earnout payments tied to regulatory authorization and revenue targets. The company will also fund $35.0 million to BankWyse, pay up to $3.0 million of closing liabilities, and assume $3.5 million of specified liabilities. The merger is subject to regulatory approvals and closing conditions.
